answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 152183 Country: INDIA Title: When does ghusl become compulsory for women? Question: When does ghusl become compulsory for women? Answer ID: 152183 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1042/962/B=10/1438) (1) When a woman has wet-dream. (2) When she does intercourse with a man. (3) When she becomes pure from haiz (menses). (5) When she becomes pure from nifas (post-partum bleeding). In all these cases ghusl becomes fardh on women. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
